W.note: Clean periodic sinusoidal drift of Figma-palette flat shapes with a seamless 5 s loop, but it is a generic shape screensaver with no choreography and the blue square and red pill read as filler.

X.note: Five flat pieces assemble, burst outward and reassemble on a dark glow with eased keyframes and a per-piece stagger, and the last keyframe equals the first so the seam is clean; the assembled cluster edges close to the Figma mark arrangement and the lighter-blend blooms look a little muddy.

Y.note: The selection-handles-on-a-square idea is a nice Figma UI reference, but the starburst's CSS transform overrides its SVG translate so it is pinned to the top-left corner in every frame, which is a visible bug, and the motion is only two simple beats.

Z.note: Staggered overshooting assembly of five pieces on a dark glow is well timed and loops cleanly, but the assembled frame is essentially the Figma logo itself, which goes against the no-logo-copying rule, and the long empty gap near the end of the cycle drags.
